# Irrigated land area

New Zealand field boundaries (2017, 2020) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Aqualinc Research Limited. License: CC-BY-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/nz/latest/nz.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/nz/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:2193; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: id, admin:subdivision_code, determination:datetime, type, geometry, collection, metrics:area, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/nz/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/nz/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/nz/collection.json
